svg.text: Activity: top up from mobile money
Replaces the disabled /deposit endpoint. A webhook is never trusted alone: we re-query the provider and check amount and currency.
Tap Top up, enter amount, pick
Show fee and total, ask for PIN
No callback after 5 min? The reconciliation job asks
Lipila for the status, then continues from the
